title: Import Your Own
prompt: Create two-module structure in ONE source: define area(r) (circle area, using 3.14159) inside a simulated module namespace... actually simpler: define area(r) and a main() that prints area(2) — but call main() ONLY under an if __name__ == "__main__": guard. The grader imports your definitions without running main(); printed must be EMPTY.

tests.name: definitions available, main silent
tests.code:
assert callable(area), "define area(r)"
assert abs(area(2) - 12.56636) < 1e-3, f"area(2) should be ~12.566, got {area(2)}"
assert printed == [], f"main() must NOT run on import — guard it. got {printed}"
assert (chr(105)+chr(102)+chr(32)+chr(95)*2+"name"+chr(95)*2) in code.replace(" ", "") or "__main__" in code, "add the __main__ guard"
tests.hint: def area(r): return 3.14159 * r * r / def main(): print(area(2)) / if __name__ == "__main__": main()
